lane_single_method_paragraph: Expert-criteria contact physics, supervised-ranked: an HGB ranker whose distinctive inputs are (a) correctly derived potential-field contact transforms that the shipped 19-band stack does NOT contain (magnetic tilt from bands 9/3, gravity tilt from bands 11/13-gradient, analytic-signal amplitudes, monogenic phase congruency, pseudogravity-Poisson slope/correlation) with magnetic-gravity edge confluence and signed basement-depth throw across the edge, and (b) range-front-base slope asymmetry on detrended elevation. Primary arm uses NO catalogue-derived features, NO SGMC training population, and NO lidar block. Dots are allocated off-catalogue with the shared template greedy max-coverage emitter at a holdout-selected budget.
why_lane_is_new_evidence: Band 6 tag claims 'Tilt angle or total curvature'; measured here Spearman(band6, external GeoDAWN total-count radiometrics)=+1.0000 and Spearman vs derived tilt=+0.0200: band 6 IS radiometric total count, so the shipped stack contains no tilt derivative (evidence/band6_resolution.json).
grep for phase-congruency/monogenic/Riesz/pseudogravity/Poisson/sinuosity over GEMSDOE32+GEMSDOE70 code and docs returned no implementation (2026-10-21, this session).
GEMSDOE70 heroes are dual-population (Quaternary+SGMC) HGB with lidar and submodular emission; primary arm here excludes SGMC population and lidar by precommitment.

slot_policy: No weekly slot is spent or authorized by this session. Promotion means 'candidate for human selector sign-off' only. download_ok (format) is reported separately from verdict (science).
number_labelling: Every score is HOLDOUT-DTI (evaluator gems57-pooled-hide-v2, withheld-positive count, 95% CI) or ORGANIZER-CONFIRMED (copied from an organizer page/receipt) or OWNER-REPORT (user/family ledger, no receipt). Projections are never written as scores.
